html:
This afternoon tour brings you from Da Nang’s most sacred pagoda to the mystical Marble Mountains and the magical lantern town of Hoi An. It’s a perfect mix of culture, spirituality, and night-time charm.

ITINERARY

13:45–14:30 – Hotel Pick-up

Driver and English-speaking guide pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang.

Linh Ung Pagoda (Son Tra Peninsula)

Visit Linh Ung Pagoda, the most important pagoda in Da Nang for Buddhist locals.

  • Admire the towering Lady Buddha statue watching over the sea.

  • Enjoy peaceful temple grounds, bonsai gardens, and panoramic views of Da Nang City and the coastline.
    This is a meaningful spiritual stop where many people come to pray for peace and good fortune.

Marble Mountain (Ngu Hanh Son)

Continue to Marble Mountain, a famous spiritual and natural complex:

  • The mountain cluster consists of Kim (Metal), Mộc (Wood), Thủy (Water), Hỏa (Fire), Thổ (Earth), symbolizing the five elements of the universe in Asian culture.

  • Explore mysterious caves filled with Buddhist shrines and a sacred atmosphere.

  • Visit Tam Thai Pagoda and Linh Ung Pagoda (at Marble Mountain).

  • Stop by Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village at the foot of the mountain to admire exquisite stone sculptures made by skillful local artisans.

18:00 – Depart to Hoi An Ancient Town

On arrival in Hoi An:

Dinner in Hoi An

Enjoy a special local dinner with unique dishes such as:

  • Cao Lau

  • Hoanh Thanh (wontons)

  • Banh Bao

  • Banh Vac (white rose dumplings)
    …and more.

Hoi An Ancient Town by Night

After dinner, explore the charming UNESCO World Heritage old town:

  • Visit the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge, the last remaining symbol of Japanese culture in Hoi An and now a symbol of the town.

  • Take a leisurely walk along the Hoai River, enjoy the romantic and lively night atmosphere.

  • Admire countless colorful lanterns hanging across streets, shop fronts, and small alleys, creating a peaceful and dreamy scene that makes you want the walk to last forever.

21:00–21:30 – Drop-off at Your Hotel

Return to your hotel in Da Nang.

End of services. Goodbye & see you again!

TOUR PRICE

25 USD / pax

INCLUDED

  • Transfer by air-conditioned coach in good condition.

  • Dinner with special local dishes in Hoi An.

  • English-speaking guide.

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing as per itinerary.

  • Mineral water on the coach.

NOTES AND CHILDREN POLICY

Notes:
